title: bug: snprintf keystore path not checked for truncation
description: In wp11_pkcs11.c:2245-2247, the keystore path is constructed with snprintf into a 256-byte buffer using $HOME, but the return value is not checked. If $HOME is >=200 bytes, the constructed path is silently truncated, pointing to the wrong file. An attacker controlling $HOME could redirect keystore load to an unintended path. Fix: check snprintf return value against sizeof(buf) and return an error if truncated.
